_doc: Reviewed findings deliberately left in place. Each entry needs fingerprint (<rule>:<file>:<line> as reported by diagnose.py), reason, owner, accepted_on and expires_on (YYYY-MM-DD, at most 12 months later), optional ticket. Expired or malformed entries count as outstanding and block the stamp; entries that no longer match a finding are reported as stale.

accepted.reason: ONLYOFFICE DocumentServer vendor image runs supervisord/nginx/postgres as root and needs CHOWN/SETUID; cannot be hardened without a vendor rebuild. Mitigations: dedicated namespace, default-deny NetworkPolicy, Istio AuthorizationPolicy, no host namespaces/privileged (pss-baseline). Tracked for the vendor-image rebuild.

Gotenberg writes conversion scratch files under /tmp; read-only root needs explicit emptyDir mounts for every Chromium/LibreOffice scratch path — scheduled with the vendor-image hardening pass.

Velero backs up and restores every API resource, so the server role needs cluster-wide get/list/watch and create/update/patch/delete on */*, plus bind/escalate to restore RBAC objects. This IS the least-privilege replacement for the chart's cluster-admin binding (audit H-4.12); residual risk documented on the ClusterRole annotation.
